text:
Nora S: Starting Azure-specific checklist for marketplace listing. Key differences vs AWS/GCP: offer templates, plan-based SKUs, VHD signing, and publisher support contact. Need: signed VHD artifact, offer/plan JSON, pricing tiers, support email mapping, and tax/contact for EU regions. Can folks ACK what they own?

Ethan M: I can own the offer/plan JSON and SKU mapping. Planning 3 plans (trial, standard, enterprise). Question: Azure accepts trials as 30-day trial flags on the plan, but we wanted 14 across other clouds. Should we do 14 here too?

Sam L (legal): From contracts view, 14 is ok but Azure portal shows 30 prominently; if we set 14 we must ensure the UX doesn't mislead customers. I'll add language to the offer legal blurb and include refund/termination terms.

Aisha R (finance): Need to know if we are doing marketplace-managed billing or redirect to our billing. Marketplace-managed simplifies checkout but Azure fees apply. Pinged billing ops for a cost/fee breakdown.

Nora S: Note on VHD signing: Azure requires a signed image for certified offers. DevOps needs to produce a signed artifact and pass MS validation. @Kai T can you handle the image signing and certificate?

Kai T: Yep. I'll generate a code-signing cert (or use existing org cert) and sign the VHD. Need to know the build pipeline step where signing happens so we can attach signature to the VHD before upload. Also, what's the naming convention for the offer version?

Ethan M: We'll follow pattern `redwood-inference-<version>-<region>`. I'll update the packager to emit both `offer.json` and `plan_<plan>.json`. For trial length, can we map internal `trial_days`=14 to Azure's `trialDurationInDays`? I can add mapping.

DevOps-bot: pipeline-bot: New Azure pipeline created: `marketplace-publish-azure` (link: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/azure-marketplace).

Kai T: Pipeline link received. I'll add signing stage after image bake and before VHD upload. Also adding checksum artifact to the package.

Sam L (legal): Heads-up: include export control disclaimer for cryptographic signing in the legal blurb. Also add support contact and SLA summary into the offer metadata.

Nora S: For support mapping: use `support@redwood.ai` for basic, `ent-support@redwood.ai` for enterprise. Make sure those appear in the publisher portal config.

Aisha R (finance): Finance asks for tax entity mapping per-region (UK/EU vs US). I'll provide the VAT/gst GUIDs to attach to the offer. Need that by EOD Wed.

Ethan M: I'll draft `offer.json` and share at `gs://redwood-marketplace/azure/offers/draft-offer.json`. It will include plans, pricing, and `support` fields. Expect PR later today.

Kai T: Quick question on validation: do we want to run the MS publisher validation in staging first or go straight to preview? I'd prefer staging to catch schema errors.

Nora S: Staging first. Also blocker: we need the publisher account verification with Microsoft completed (two-factor + org attestation). @Ethan M can you confirm we have publisher access?

Ethan M: I have publisher access but need co-admin for the marketplace listing. Requested co-admin invite for Nora and Kai.

Sam L (legal): Uploaded a short legal snippet to include in the offer description: https://drive.redwood/legal/azure-marketplace-offer-snippet.md. Please do not edit without legal review.

DevOps-bot: notify: Publisher co-admin invites sent to Nora S and Kai T.

Aisha R (finance): Finance has shared VAT ids to Nora via secure doc.

Ethan M: PR created for offer + plan JSON: https://git.redwood/marketplace/azure/pulls/12. Includes mapping script to normalize `trial_days` -> `trialDurationInDays`.

Kai T: Signed VHD workflow added to pipeline. Will post signed artifact link when available.

Nora S: Okay owners: Ethan -> offer JSON + publisher invites, Kai -> VHD signing + pipeline, Sam -> offer legal snippet + export control line, Aisha -> tax IDs. Target: submit to MS staging by Friday COB. Any objections?

Sam L (legal): No objections. Will review PR tomorrow AM.

Ethan M: No objections.

Kai T: All good.

Nora S: Great. I'll run a 20-min sync tomorrow 9:30am to walk through the submission checklist. Agenda: publisher access, signed VHD, offer JSON walkthrough, support mapping. See you then :calendar:
